title: 第24章
content:
“妍儿，你瞎说什么呢？”苏瑶立刻否认。可在她身后的陈青云，却没有丝毫的怜香惜玉，反而继续加速……“啊啊啊！”苏瑶简直快要咬破嘴唇，但还是忍不住叫出了声。“姐，你当我是三岁小孩么，这声音明明就是在……”电话那头，苏妍儿也察觉到了异样，听得面红耳赤。“妍儿，我不是在偷野男人，是和我老公！”苏瑶知道瞒不住了，只能找了个借口。老公？听到这个称呼，陈青云却觉得更加兴奋，甚至还大着胆子，故意惹的苏瑶娇哼连连。“姐，原来你在和姐夫干那事，那我就不打扰你了！”苏妍儿没想到姐姐如此大胆，羞的不敢再说什么，连忙挂断了电话。卧室内。苏瑶香汗淋漓，回头瞪了陈青云一眼，嗔怪道：“坏蛋，刚才差点就被妍儿发现了！”陈青云却笑道：“嫂子，放心吧，我又没出声，妍儿总不可能去找戴斌当面对质吧？接下来，就让我这个‘老公’，好好满足你吧！”言罢，陈青云又开始了新一轮的冲锋，年轻活力，热情四射。“啊！你这个混蛋……”苏瑶嘴上说着不要，但成熟如水蜜桃般的身子却迎合起来，与陈青云紧紧交缠在一起。……足足过了大半个小时，陈青云才鸣金收兵，一脸的享受。真润！不得不承认，苏瑶身上那种少妇独有的风情和韵味，是她妹妹所没有的，能给男人带来最大的享受。此刻，苏瑶躺在床上，紧闭双眼，双腿都在轻微发颤，整个人仿佛都要累瘫了。刚才那巨大的冲击，是她从未有过的体验，仿佛从灵魂到身子，都被陈青云彻底征服！见她这幅被玩坏的样子，陈青云立刻掏出手机，悄悄拍了几张照片。既然她想要自己的把柄，那可别怪他不客气了！又休息了好几分钟，苏瑶才缓过神来，睁开眼望着陈青云，嗔怪道：“讨厌，你把人家身上都掐红了，是要折腾死我么？”“嫂子，你没听说过那句话么？只有累死的牛，没有耕坏的田！”陈青云抱着她，笑着说道：“对了！你和戴斌结婚那么久还没孩子，该不会是身子有病吧？”“胡说！”苏瑶一下子急了，眼圈泛红委屈说道：“戴斌每次忙活两分钟就不行了，他种子不好，能怪我么？”“既然这样，那今后我多来帮帮你吧，争取让你赶紧怀个大胖小子！”陈青云说道。“什么？！”苏瑶脸色大变，惊呼出声：“陈青云，你不说只要我满足你一次，就可以高抬贵手么，你还想有下次？”“之前的事情，的确一笔勾销了！不过现在，我拍了你的照片，不想这些照片泄露出去，你还是乖乖听我的话吧！”陈青云掏出手机，打开相册，展示刚才拍下的那些……只见照片中的苏瑶，非但一丝不挂，身上甚至还有陈青云留下的痕迹。“你……你这个混蛋，就知道欺负我！”苏瑶又羞又怒，伸手想要去抢夺手机。陈青云收起手机，冷笑一声：“别白费力气了！这些照片我已经上传到云盘，就算你删掉也没用！”

听到这话，苏瑶一下子慌了，心中更是懊悔无比。早知如此，就算戴斌跪下来求她，她也不会施展什么“美人计”！“嫂子，放心，只要你乖乖听我的话，我也不会伤害你！但如果你动什么歪心思，别怪我翻脸，听明白了么？”陈青云警告道。“明白了。”苏瑶虽然心中屈辱，却无可奈何。她知道，现在自己没有任何筹码，今后必须臣服于陈青云，哪怕让她喊主人，也只能做。“过来！”陈青云拍了拍自己的大腿，示意她坐过来。苏瑶犹豫了一下，还是主动靠了过去，用自己的娇躯伺候着陈青云，让他十分受用。“对了，你妹妹口中的肖少，是什么人？”陈青云问道。“他叫肖阳，据说是市里某个领导的儿子，对妍儿一见钟情，最近送了很多礼物，还替她搞定了电视台的工作！”苏瑶回答。陈青云眼神一寒，心中有些不爽。刚分手不久，没想到苏妍儿就找到了下家……“那她和肖阳，发展到什么地步了？”陈青云又问。“你放心吧，妍儿一向守身如玉，还是处子，婚前不会和男人发生关系的！”苏瑶生怕他不开心，连忙解释起来。“以后你妹和肖阳的事情，都要尽快汇报给我！”陈青云吩咐道。“好。”苏瑶点头。“时间不早了，我先回去，你把屋子打扫一下吧！”陈青云拍了拍她的屁股，随后起身离开。等他走后，苏瑶也下了床，然而当玉足踩地的瞬间，却忍不住倒吸冷气。“嘶……”她的柳眉蹙在一起，只觉得双腿一阵痛楚，甚至都有些站不稳。但现在，整间卧室经历了疯狂的大战，一片狼藉，到处都是她和陈青云留下的……苏瑶只能强忍着痛楚，开始清扫起来。但她的脑海中，又忍不住浮现出陈青云那强大的身姿。女人都是慕强的，苏瑶也不例外。哪怕陈青云蛮不讲理，横冲直撞，甚至有些粗鲁，却还是征服了她的心。……又过了十几分钟。“老婆，我回来了！”戴斌一副灰头土脸的样子，急匆匆推开了大门。刚才，因为工作上的一个错误，他被县长宁轻眉喊过去，狠狠训斥了一顿。不过一想到美人计成功，陈青云马上要锒铛入狱，他就觉得挨一顿骂根本不算什么。只要将陈青云解决掉，那他说不定能取而代之，成为宁县长的新秘书。一想到宁轻眉那绝色的容颜，如同高岭之花的气质，戴斌就有些激动。别说挨骂了，哪怕让他去舔宁轻眉的高跟鞋，他都觉得是莫大的荣幸！“砰！”这时，苏瑶推开了卧室大门走了出来，她换上了一件单薄睡衣，难掩傲人丰腴的身材。戴斌却直勾勾望着她，面露狐疑之色：“老婆，你看起来怎么怪怪的？”　　请记住本书首发域名：fzhldax。顶点小说网手机版阅读网址：fzhldax

"Yan'er, what are you talking about?" Su Yao immediately denied it.But Chen Qingyun behind her did not show any pity for her, but continued to speed up... "Ahhh!" Su Yao almost bit her lip, but she couldn't help but screamed."Sister, do you think I'm a three-year-old child? This voice is obviously..." On the other end of the phone, Su Yan'er also noticed something strange and blushed."Yan'er, I'm not stealing from a wild man, I'm with my husband!" Su Yao knew she couldn't hide it anymore, so she could only find an excuse.husband?Hearing this title, Chen Qingyun felt even more excited, and even had the courage to deliberately provoke Su Yao to moan repeatedly."Sister, it turns out you are doing that with your brother-in-law, so I won't bother you anymore!" Su Yan'er didn't expect her sister to be so bold. She was too embarrassed to say anything and hung up the phone quickly.In the bedroom.Su Yaoxiang was dripping with sweat. She turned around and glared at Chen Qingyun, saying angrily: "Bad guy, Yan'er almost discovered you just now!" But Chen Qingyun smiled and said: "Sister-in-law, don't worry, I didn't say anything. It's impossible for Yan'er to confront Dai Bin, right? Next, let me, my 'husband', satisfy you!" After that, Chen Qingyun started a new round of charge, young and energetic, full of enthusiasm."Ah! You bastard..." Su Yao said no, but her mature peach-like body catered to her and was tightly intertwined with Chen Qingyun....After more than half an hour, Chen Qingyun finally retreated with a look of enjoyment on his face.So moist!I have to admit that Su Yao has the unique style and charm of a young woman that her sister does not have, and can bring the greatest enjoyment to men.At this moment, Su Yao was lying on the bed, closing her eyes tightly, her legs were trembling slightly, and her whole body seemed to be paralyzed by fatigue.The huge impact just now was an experience she had never experienced before. It was as if she was completely conquered by Chen Qingyun from soul to body!Seeing her spoiled look, Chen Qingyun immediately took out his mobile phone and secretly took a few photos.Since she wants her own leverage, don't blame him for being rude!After resting for several minutes, Su Yao regained her composure, opened her eyes and looked at Chen Qingyun, and said angrily: "I hate it, you pinched me all red, are you going to torture me to death?" "Sister-in-law, haven't you heard of that sentence? There are only exhausted cows, not plowed fields!" Chen Qingyun hugged her and said with a smile: "By the way! You and Dai Bin are getting married.You haven't had a baby for so long.Could it be that you are sick?" "Nonsense!" Su Yao suddenly became anxious and said with red eyes, "Dai Bin can't work for two minutes at a time.Can he blame me?" "In this case, I will help you more in the future and try to get you pregnant as soon as possible!" Chen Qingyun said."What?!" Su Yao's face changed drastically and she exclaimed: "Chen Qingyun, didn't you say that as long as I satisfy you once, you can show your favor? Do you still want a next time?" "The previous things have indeed been written off! But now, I took your photo, I don’t want these photos to be leaked, so you should just listen to me!" Chen Qingyun took out his mobile phone, opened the photo album, and showed the ones he just took... Su Yao in the photos was not only naked, but there were even traces of Chen Qingyun on her body."You...you bastard, you know how to bully me!" Su Yao was ashamed and angry, reaching out to grab the phone.Chen Qingyun put away his phone and sneered: "Don't waste your efforts! I have uploaded these photos to the cloud disk, it will be useless even if you delete them!"

When Su Yao heard this, she panicked and felt extremely regretful.If she had known this, even if Dai Bin knelt down to beg her, she would not have used any "beauty trap"!"Sister-in-law, don't worry, as long as you obey me, I won't hurt you! But if you have any evil intentions, don't blame me for falling out. Do you understand?" Chen Qingyun warned."I understand." Although Su Yao felt humiliated, she was helpless.She knew that she didn't have any leverage now, and she had to surrender to Chen Qingyun from now on. Even if she was asked to call her master, she could only do it."Come here!" Chen Qingyun patted his thigh and motioned for her to sit over.Su Yao hesitated for a moment, then took the initiative to lean over and serve Chen Qingyun with her delicate body, which was very useful to him."By the way, who is Mr. Xiao that your sister talks about?" Chen Qingyun asked."His name is Xiao Yang. It is said that he is the son of a certain leader in the city. He fell in love with Yan'er at first sight. He has given her a lot of gifts recently and even helped her with the work of the TV station!" Su Yao replied.Chen Qingyun's eyes turned cold and he felt a little unhappy.Not long after they broke up, Su Yan'er unexpectedly found a new partner... "Then how far have she and Xiao Yang developed?" Chen Qingyun asked again."Don't worry, Yan'er has always been a virgin and will not have sex with men before marriage!" Su Yao explained quickly for fear that he would be unhappy."From now on, everything about your sister and Xiao Yang must be reported to me as soon as possible!" Chen Qingyun ordered."Okay." Su Yao nodded."It's getting late, I'll go back first, you can clean the house!" Chen Qingyun patted her butt, then got up and left.After he left, Su Yao also got out of bed. However, when her feet stepped on the ground, she couldn't help but gasp."Hiss..." Her eyebrows knitted together, and she felt a pain in her legs, making her even a little unsteady.But now, the whole bedroom has experienced a crazy battle and is in a mess. Everything left by her and Chen Qingyun is everywhere... Su Yao can only endure the pain and start cleaning.But in her mind, she couldn't help but think of Chen Qingyun's powerful figure.Women are all strong-willed, and Su Yao is no exception.Even though Chen Qingyun was unreasonable, rampant, and even a little rude, he still conquered her heart....Another ten minutes passed."Honey, I'm back!" Dai Bin looked shabby and hurriedly opened the door.Just now, because of a mistake at work, he was called over by the county magistrate Ning Qingmei and severely reprimanded him.But when he thought that the honey trap was successful and Chen Qingyun was about to go to jail, he felt that being scolded was nothing at all.As long as Chen Qingyun is eliminated, he might be able to replace him and become County Magistrate Ning's new secretary.Dai Bin was a little excited when he thought of Ning Qingmei's stunning face and temperament like a flower on the high mountain.Not to mention being scolded, even if he was asked to lick Ning Qingmei's high heels, he would feel it was a great honor!"Bang!" At this time, Su Yao opened the bedroom door and walked out. She put on a thin pajamas, which could not hide her proud and plump figure.Dai Bin looked at her with suspicion: "Honey, why do you look so weird?"
